name: comp-543
title: Avatar Image Uploader
description: A compact profile-picture picker: a dashed circle with a person icon that opens a file dialog or takes a dropped image, then shows the photo with a small remove button.
use: A profile picture needs a compact picker that also accepts a dragged image.
avoid: One image only, with no crop or zoom, and the 64px circle is a small touch target.
a11y: Names and alt text are present; dropping needs a pointer, and there is no upload progress or error message in the UI. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A single dashed circle the size of a profile picture sits centered on the dark page, holding a small outline person icon. When an image is chosen it fills the circle edge to edge and a round white X badge appears at the top right.
behaves: Hovering tints the dashed circle and dragging a file darkens it, while a click opens the file picker. Picking an image swaps the icon for a cover-cropped preview and adds the remove badge.
customise: No props: the file is picked at runtime. Circle size, accepted type and accent colours live in the source or theme tokens.
weight: light: One small button and a single preview image; nothing loops.
